observation_schema: tcp_pos (xyz of gripper), cube_pos (xyz), target_pos (xyz), gripper_open (0=closed..1=open), dist_tcp_cube, dist_cube_target, cube_height (z of cube; table~0.03)
meta_policy_notes: Hierarchical NEXUS agent for PandaPickCube. Skills are designed to be permissive and overlapping, allowing the high-level policy to choose among multiple plausible options. Reward functions provide dense gradients, prioritizing primary progress terms. Thresholds are generous to ensure broad availability.

skills.name: reach_cube
skills.description: Move the gripper towards the cube to prepare for grasping.

reward_terms.description: Encourage gripper to get close to the cube.

skills.name: grasp_cube
skills.description: Close the gripper to grasp the cube.

reward_terms.description: Encourage staying close to the cube while grasping.

skills.name: lift_cube
skills.description: Lift the grasped cube above the table.

reward_terms.description: Encourage lifting the cube to a target height.
Encourage maintaining a closed gripper (strong grasp).

skills.name: move_cube_to_target
skills.description: Move the grasped and lifted cube towards the target location.

reward_terms.description: Encourage moving the cube closer to the target.
Encourage maintaining the cube's height while moving.
Encourage maintaining a closed gripper (grasp) while moving.
